attributes.name: Asmodean High Priest
attributes.powers:
When you would recharge, discard, or bury a spell that has the Divine trait, discard a card that has the Corrupted trait to put the spell in your hand instead.

Discard this card to explore your location. During this exploration, add 2d6 and the Divine trait to your checks to defeat banes.
